title: encompass — deserve

sentences.sentence: His repertoire encompassed everything from Bach to Schoenberg.
sentences.translation: 他的表演曲目从巴赫到勋伯格，样样俱全。

sentences.sentence: Flats outnumber houses in this area.
sentences.translation: 这个地区公寓房比独栋房子多。

sentences.sentence: His troops were hopelessly outnumbered.
sentences.translation: 他的军队在数量上远远不及对方。

sentences.sentence: He had a long, curved scar on his right cheek.
sentences.translation: 他的右脸上有一道弯弯的长疤。

sentences.sentence: a deep cut that could leave a permanent scar
sentences.translation: 可能会留下永久性疤痕的一道很深的伤口

sentences.sentence: Diabetics cannot metabolize glucose properly.
sentences.translation: 糖尿病患者不能使葡萄糖进行恰当的新陈代谢。

translations.translation: 管理, 给予, 执行

sentences.sentence: The money will be administered by local charities.
sentences.translation: 这笔资金将由当地慈善机构管理。

sentences.sentence: Our office administers the affairs of the Society.
sentences.translation: 我们办公室管理协会的事务。

phrases.translation: v. 集中于；把...强加于；纠缠；抓住，紧紧握住

sentences.sentence: Make sure all the windows are securely fastened before you leave.
sentences.translation: 离开前要确保所有的窗子都已关严。

translations.translation: 使多样化, 作多样性的投资

sentences.sentence: User requirements have diversified over the years.
sentences.translation: 这几年来，用户需求已经多样化。

sentences.sentence: My only grumble is that there isn't a non-smoking section.
sentences.translation: 我惟一的抱怨是这儿没有无烟区。

translations.translation: 降级, 降格, 退化

phrases.translation: 环境退化；环境质量下降

sentences.sentence: ...air pollution, traffic congestion, and the steady degradation of our quality of life.
sentences.translation: …空气污染、交通阻塞以及我们生活质量的持续恶化。

sentences.sentence: European farmers are planning a massive demonstration against farm subsidy cuts.
sentences.translation: 欧洲的农场主们正在策划一场反对削减农场补贴的大游行。

sentences.sentence: I mean, in spite of this commonsense explanation, we are going to see how to prove this.
sentences.translation: 我的意思是，不管常识怎么解释的，我们都将看看如何证明这个定理。

sentences.sentence: If you now look at Hume's have to say about science, a lot of it will look like commonsense.
sentences.translation: 如果你现在看看休谟关于自然科学所说的内容，里面的大部分看起来像是常识。

sentences.sentence: At the time it was very far from commonsense and it's a mark of how far we have come that we now accept the ultimate principles of science are ones that we cannot hope to base on pure reason.
sentences.translation: 但是当那些内容远没有成为常识的时代,当我们如今已经接受的,自然科学和最终原理还未被采纳的时代,我们不能寄希望于纯粹的推理。

phrases.translation: 旅游胜地；旅游目的地；旅游景点

sentences.sentence: Ellis Island has become one of America's most popular tourist destinations.
sentences.translation: 埃利斯岛已经成为美国最受欢迎的游览地之一。

translations.translation: 黄石国家公园, 黄石河

phrases.translation: 黄石国家公园（美国第一个国家公园）
黄石河（河流名，位于美国西北部）

sentences.sentence: The male mosquito never stings.
sentences.translation: 雄蚊不叮。

sentences.sentence: Are your mosquito bites still itching?
sentences.translation: 你被蚊子咬的地方还痒吗?

sentences.sentence: The frog darted out its tongue to catch a mosquito.
sentences.translation: 这只青蛙突然伸出舌头捕捉蚊子。

sentences.sentence: People with the virus may feel perfectly well, but they can still infect others.
sentences.translation: 带有这种病毒的人可能毫无症状，却仍可能传染他人。

sentences.sentence: What have I done to deserve this?
sentences.translation: 我做了什么事，要得到这样的报应？

sentences.sentence: I’m sorry for the kids. They deserve better (= deserve to be treated in a better way ) .
sentences.translation: 我为这些孩子感到难过，他们应该过得更好。

sentences.sentence: Ledley deserves a place in the team.
sentences.translation: 莱德利应该在队里占有一席之地。

sentences.sentence: Paula deserves a special mention for all the help she has given us.
sentences.translation: 应该特别提一下葆拉，她给了我们许多帮助。

sentences.sentence: I would never hit anyone, even if they deserved it.
sentences.translation: 我决不会打人，哪怕他欠揍。

sentences.sentence: What has he done to deserve this punishment ?
sentences.translation: 他做了什么，竟会受到这样的惩罚？

sentences.sentence: People who are sent to prison for drunk-driving get what they deserve .
sentences.translation: 那些醉酒驾车被送进监狱的人是罪有应得的。

text:
英语词汇 · 托福 · 第 282 单元

encompass
音标：英 /ɪn'kʌmpəs; en-/  美 /ɪn'kʌmpəs/
v. 包围,环绕
例句：His repertoire encompassed everything from Bach to Schoenberg.
他的表演曲目从巴赫到勋伯格，样样俱全。

outnumber
音标：英 /aʊt'nʌmbə/  美 /'aʊt'nʌmbɚ/
v. 数目超过, 比多
例句：Flats outnumber houses in this area.
这个地区公寓房比独栋房子多。
例句：His troops were hopelessly outnumbered.
他的军队在数量上远远不及对方。

scar
音标：英 /skɑː/  美 /skɑr/
n. 伤痕,疤痕
v. 结疤,使留下伤痕
短语：scar tissue — [医]瘢痕组织
例句：He had a long, curved scar on his right cheek.
他的右脸上有一道弯弯的长疤。
例句：a deep cut that could leave a permanent scar
可能会留下永久性疤痕的一道很深的伤口

metabolize
音标：英 /mɪ'tæbəlaɪz/  美 /mɛ'tæbəlaɪz/
v. 产生代谢变化
例句：Diabetics cannot metabolize glucose properly.
糖尿病患者不能使葡萄糖进行恰当的新陈代谢。

administer
音标：英 /əd'mɪnɪstə/  美 /əd'mɪnɪstɚ/
v. 管理, 给予, 执行
短语：administer justice — 执法，执行审判
例句：The money will be administered by local charities.
这笔资金将由当地慈善机构管理。
例句：Our office administers the affairs of the Society.
我们办公室管理协会的事务。

fasten
音标：英 /'fɑːs(ə)n/  美 /'fæsən/
v. 扎牢,扣住
短语：fasten on — v. 集中于；把...强加于；纠缠；抓住，紧紧握住
例句：Make sure all the windows are securely fastened before you leave.
离开前要确保所有的窗子都已关严。

diversify
音标：英 /daɪˈvɜːsɪˌfaɪ/  美 /daɪˈvɜrsəˌfaɪ/
v. 使多样化, 作多样性的投资
例句：User requirements have diversified over the years.
这几年来，用户需求已经多样化。

grumble
音标：英 /'grʌmb(ə)l/  美 /'ɡrʌmbl/
adj. 嘟囔地说
n. 怨言
v. 发牢骚
短语：grumble at — 对…表示不满；抱怨…
例句：My only grumble is that there isn't a non-smoking section.
我惟一的抱怨是这儿没有无烟区。

degradation
音标：英 /,degrə'deɪʃ(ə)n/  美 /,dɛɡrə'deʃən/
n. 降级, 降格, 退化
短语：environmental degradation — 环境退化；环境质量下降
短语：degradation mechanism — 老化机构；降解机制
短语：thermal degradation — [化]热降解
短语：microbial degradation — 微生物降解（作用）
短语：soil degradation — 土壤退化；土壤破坏
短语：oxidative degradation — [化]氧化降解；氧化降解作用
短语：degradation product — 降级产品，降解产物
短语：degradation reaction — 降解反应
短语：enzymatic degradation — 酶催降解，酶促降解
短语：biochemical degradation — 生物化学降解
短语：microbiological degradation — 微生物降解
例句：...air pollution, traffic congestion, and the steady degradation of our quality of life.
…空气污染、交通阻塞以及我们生活质量的持续恶化。

neurospora
n. [微]脉孢菌

subsidy
音标：英 /'sʌbsɪdɪ/  美 /'sʌbsədi/
n. 补助金,津贴
短语：government subsidy — 政府补助金，政府补贴
短语：export subsidy — 出口补贴
例句：European farmers are planning a massive demonstration against farm subsidy cuts.
欧洲的农场主们正在策划一场反对削减农场补贴的大游行。

commonsense
adj. 常识的,具有常识的
例句：I mean, in spite of this commonsense explanation, we are going to see how to prove this.
我的意思是，不管常识怎么解释的，我们都将看看如何证明这个定理。
例句：If you now look at Hume's have to say about science, a lot of it will look like commonsense.
如果你现在看看休谟关于自然科学所说的内容，里面的大部分看起来像是常识。
例句：At the time it was very far from commonsense and it's a mark of how far we have come that we now accept the ultimate principles of science are ones that we cannot hope to base on pure reason.
但是当那些内容远没有成为常识的时代,当我们如今已经接受的,自然科学和最终原理还未被采纳的时代,我们不能寄希望于纯粹的推理。

destination
音标：英 /,destɪ'neɪʃ(ə)n/  美 /,dɛstɪ'neʃən/
n. 目的地
短语：tourist destination — 旅游胜地；旅游目的地；旅游景点
短语：port of destination — 目的港
短语：final destination — 最终目的地
短语：destination port — 目的港；目的端口
短语：ultimate destination — 最终目的地
短语：destination airport — 目的地机场；到达机场
短语：destination node — 目的节点；目标节点
短语：country of destination — 目的国；收货地国家
短语：destination country — 前往目的地国；到达国
短语：destination address — 目标地址
短语：place of destination — 目的地
短语：destination folder — 目标文件夹
短语：destination directory — [计]目标目录，目的目录
短语：destination file — 目标文件；结果文件
例句：Ellis Island has become one of America's most popular tourist destinations.
埃利斯岛已经成为美国最受欢迎的游览地之一。

yellowstone
音标：英 /'jeləustəun/  美 /'jeləustəun/
n. 黄石国家公园, 黄石河
短语：yellowstone national park — 黄石国家公园（美国第一个国家公园）
短语：yellowstone river — 黄石河（河流名，位于美国西北部）

mosquito
音标：英 /mɒ'skiːtəʊ/  美 /məˈskiːtoʊ/
n. 蚊子
短语：mosquito net — n. 蚊帐
短语：mosquito killer — 蚊香器
例句：The male mosquito never stings.
雄蚊不叮。
例句：Are your mosquito bites still itching?
你被蚊子咬的地方还痒吗?
例句：The frog darted out its tongue to catch a mosquito.
这只青蛙突然伸出舌头捕捉蚊子。

paucity
音标：英 /'pɔːsɪtɪ/  美 /'pɔ:siti/
n. 极小量

infect
音标：英 /ɪn'fekt/  美 /ɪn'fɛkt/
v. [医] 传染, 感染
例句：People with the virus may feel perfectly well, but they can still infect others.
带有这种病毒的人可能毫无症状，却仍可能传染他人。

burin
音标：英 /'bjʊərɪn/  美 /'bjʊrɪn/
n. 冰凿,雕刻刀

walrus
音标：英 /'wɔːlrəs; 'wɒl-/  美 /'wɔlrəs/
n. [动]海象, 海象胡须

deserve
音标：英 /dɪ'zɜːv/  美 /dɪ'zɝv/
v. 应受, 值得
例句：What have I done to deserve this?
我做了什么事，要得到这样的报应？
例句：I’m sorry for the kids. They deserve better (= deserve to be treated in a better way ) .
我为这些孩子感到难过，他们应该过得更好。
例句：Ledley deserves a place in the team.
莱德利应该在队里占有一席之地。
例句：Paula deserves a special mention for all the help she has given us.
应该特别提一下葆拉，她给了我们许多帮助。
例句：I would never hit anyone, even if they deserved it.
我决不会打人，哪怕他欠揍。
例句：What has he done to deserve this punishment ?
他做了什么，竟会受到这样的惩罚？
例句：People who are sent to prison for drunk-driving get what they deserve .
那些醉酒驾车被送进监狱的人是罪有应得的。
